name: s1-transition-integrity-20260718
title: Route dev_finish and dev_merge through runStoryTransition and mutex same-owner transitions
description: dev_finish/dev_merge (handlers/worktree.ts:997,1061) write story.phase directly, bypassing runStoryTransition: no review round is minted, no phase_transition process-event is appended, and the event is mislabeled TEST. Same-owner concurrent transitions are also not serialized (transition-orchestrator.ts:425->660 non-atomic; ownership-gate.ts:282). Make both handlers delegate to runStoryTransition and hold a per-story transition lock across read->gate->persist.
